Trend-dominated series with moderate ranking stability; inverse-error weighting emphasizes the two lowest-error models (ONLY_DWT_catboost, FT_rf) while down-weighting DWT_rf, testing whether error-proportional allocation beats DBA's optimized solution.
DBA on 7-model pool5 to exploit slope diversity across clusters in a trend-dominated series with moderate ranking stability

Trimmed mean on pool4: in a trend-dominated series where models disagree on slope direction, trimming the extreme forecast at each step may reduce error vs plain mean while preserving the central tendency that DBA captures adaptively
Per-horizon top-2 adaptive weighting on the 4-model pool to exploit horizon-varying model strengths in a trend-dominated series with moderate ranking stability
